name: Tung Lo Mo
summary: A Cham Islam beef sausage, seasoned in the traditional way and fermented until it turns deep and lightly sour. It belongs to the community’s Halal cooking.
origin: The Cham Islam community in Tây Ninh.
taste: Deep and lightly sour, from a natural ferment.
howToEat: Eat it as a sausage, with the community’s other Halal plates such as cà ri bò.
where: The Cham Islam community of Tây Ninh.
seoTitle: Tung Lo Mo — Cham Islam beef sausage
seoDescription: Tung Lò Mò, a fermented Cham Islam beef sausage, deep and lightly sour.
